{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bayonard Institute of Higher Education''' was an educational establishment that was located in the city of [[Bayonard]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==History==
The Institute operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It attracted a number of investors and supporters and by about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], was attempting to become the first university on Cularin.
